description: This file defines the CommandParser class used for parsing command strings in a modem simulator context. It includes methods for skipping prefixes, extracting strings and integers, and manipulating command strings.

classes.name: CommandParser
classes.description: A class for parsing command strings, providing methods to skip parts of the command and extract data.

methods.name: SkipPrefix
methods.description: Skips the substring before the first '=' character, including '='.

methods.name: SkipPrefixAT
methods.description: Skips the next occurrence of 'AT' in the command string.

methods.name: SkipComma
methods.description: Skips the next comma in the command string.

methods.name: SkipWhiteSpace
methods.description: Skips the next whitespace character in the command string.

methods.name: GetNextStr
methods.description: Retrieves the next string segment from the command.

methods.name: GetNextStr(char flag)
methods.description: Retrieves the next string segment from the command, considering a specific flag.

methods.name: GetNextStrDeciToHex
methods.description: Converts a decimal string to hexadecimal, used for AT+CRSM commands.

methods.name: GetNextInt
methods.description: Retrieves the next integer value from the command.

methods.name: GetNextHexInt
methods.description: Retrieves the next hexadecimal integer value from the command.
